title.original: HiveMind: Contribution-Guided Online Prompt Optimization of LLM Multi-Agent Systems
title.zh: HiveMind：LLM多智能体系统的贡献引导在线提示优化
title.en: HiveMind: Contribution-Guided Online Prompt Optimization of LLM Multi-Agent Systems

inclusion_reason.zh: HiveMind 的 DAG-Shapley 归因服务和在线提示更新闭环是可部署的多 Agent 观测与自优化机制。
inclusion_reason.en: HiveMind's DAG-Shapley attribution service and online prompt-update loop constitute a deployable observability and self-optimization mechanism for multi-agent systems.

abstract.zh: HiveMind 以 Agent 贡献归因为反馈，在线改写低贡献角色的提示；DAG-Shapley 利用工作流结构降低 Shapley 计算成本。
abstract.en: HiveMind uses agent-contribution attribution to rewrite underperforming role prompts online, while DAG-Shapley exploits workflow structure to reduce Shapley computation.

problem.zh: 静态多 Agent 提示无法随运行表现修正，经典 Shapley 又需枚举大量联盟，难用于在线识别和优化低效 Agent。
problem.en: Static multi-agent prompts cannot adapt to observed performance, and classical Shapley enumeration is too expensive for online diagnosis and optimization.

approach.zh: 系统在工作流 DAG 上剪枝不可能联盟、复用中间输出计算贡献，再让 CG-OPO 根据量化贡献自动细化目标 Agent 提示。
approach.en: The system prunes infeasible coalitions on the workflow DAG, reuses intermediate outputs to estimate contribution, and lets CG-OPO refine prompts from those scores.

system_design.zh: 运行时记录 DAG 依赖和节点输出，DAG-Shapley 服务生成贡献分，选择器标记低贡献 Agent，提示优化器在线提出并验证更新。
system_design.en: The runtime records DAG dependencies and node outputs; DAG-Shapley scores contributions, a selector flags weak agents, and a prompt optimizer proposes and tests updates online.

key_results.zh: 在多 Agent 股票交易中，HiveMind 优于静态基线，DAG-Shapley 在保持接近完整归因的同时大幅减少 LLM 调用。
key_results.en: In multi-agent stock trading, HiveMind outperforms static baselines, and DAG-Shapley greatly reduces LLM calls while retaining attribution close to full Shapley.

limitations.zh: 证据来自单一交易场景，Shapley 仍假设可比较的联盟价值；提示优化可能过拟合短期收益或把环境噪声误归因给 Agent。
limitations.en: Evidence comes from one trading setting, Shapley still assumes comparable coalition values, and prompt updates may overfit short-term returns or attribute environment noise to agents.

metrics.name: Reduction in LLM calls with DAG-Shapley

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
